migration_notes: The legacy Python feature kinds are helical_gear and bevel_gear, with the listed module, teeth, width, angle, bore, center, and segment parameters.
A bare '斜齿轮' without parameter cues falls through the old Quick generic gear branch and builds an ordinary gear with module=2, teeth=20, height=10.
The old helical_gear geometry builder records helix_deg but builds a straight trapezoidal tooth prism; this is not a true helical tooth surface.

legacy_mesh_geometry.volume_mm3 is the legacy polygon-kernel K.volume_of metric. legacy_occt_brep is measured separately through Document.build_brep(); only BREP volume is compared with Rust OCCT BREP volume.
